start: Workout plans, signed in as the owner, a saved plan with one exercise, gym online

steps.action: Open Workout plans, tap Edit on a plan, find an exercise and tap "+ Add your video"
user_sees: A box "Your video of it (YouTube link, optional)" with the hint "Members see “Watch your trainer” on this exercise in their app."
must_not: The box is missing although the gym server has form videos switched on

steps.action: Paste "youtu.be/AbC123xyz" (no https in front)
user_sees: The link as typed, no red line under the box
must_not: A red line for a real YouTube link

steps.action: Tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The sheet closes; a short note "“<plan name>” updated."
must_not: The link saved with http or without https
The capital letters of the video id changed to small letters
The plan saved twice

start: Workout plans, the plan builder open on an exercise, signed in as the owner

steps.action: Tap "+ Add your video" and paste a link that is not YouTube (an Instagram or Vimeo link)
user_sees: A red line under the box: "Paste a YouTube link (youtube.com or youtu.be)."
must_not: No warning until Save

steps.action: Tap "Save changes" anyway
user_sees: The sheet stays open with "<exercise> (<day>): the video link must be a YouTube link (youtube.com or youtu.be)."
must_not: The plan saved with the bad link
The typed link wiped from the box
The bad link reaching a member's phone

steps.action: Paste a link longer than 300 letters, then tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The same refusal in plain words
must_not: A link cut short and saved without a word

start: A plan whose exercise already has a saved YouTube link, signed in as the owner

steps.action: Open Workout plans and tap Edit on the plan
user_sees: The video box is already open on that exercise, with the saved link
must_not: The box folded away so the saved link looks lost

steps.action: Clear the box and tap "Save changes"
user_sees: "“<plan name>” updated."
must_not: The old link still sent to members
A refusal because the box is empty

steps.action: Open the plan again
user_sees: "+ Add your video" on that exercise again
must_not: The removed link back in the box

steps.action: Type a new link and save
user_sees: "“<plan name>” updated."
must_not: Two links kept for one exercise

start: The plan builder, an exercise with the video box open

steps.action: Paste a look-alike link: "https://youtube.com.example.org/watch?v=1", then one with a name and @ before the site, then one with a port number
user_sees: The red line "Paste a YouTube link (youtube.com or youtu.be)." each time
must_not: Any of the three accepted
A member's phone opening a site that is not YouTube

steps.action: Paste a real link and save; the plan is sent to two members
user_sees: "“<plan name>” updated."
must_not: The link shown to members the plan was not sent to
The trainer's name or phone number sent along with the link
